title: I WONDER WHY WE HOLD ON
lyrics_plain:
Love is a hunger, that burns in my soul
But you never noticed the pain
But love is an anchor, that won't let me go
I reach out to hold you
But you pushed me away
And you always convinced me to stay
And I wonder why we hold on
With tears in our eyes
And I wonder why we have to break down
To make things alright
And I wonder why I can't sing
And tell you goodbye
Yeah, I wonder why
Well, I'm no ranger, with my selfish pride
But I love you more everyday
And love is an anger, that builds up inside
As the tears of frustration go down my face
Why does love always have to turn out this way
And I wonder why we hold on
With tears in our eyes
And I wonder why we have to break down
To just think things right
And I wonder why I can't sing
And tell you goodbye
Oh, I wonder why
I don't wanna fight again tonight
About the little things, please baby
I just wanna try my way back to love
Oh, and I'll meet you there, baby
I wonder why we hold on
With tears in our eyes
And I wonder why, I wonder why
We have to break down
To just think things right
And I wonder why I can't sing
To tell you goodbye
Yeah, I wonder why
Oh, babe and I wonder why
I wonder why, wonder why
And I wonder why
I wonder why, wonder why
